Identity theft alert: Someone else used my student ID to pay their fees via a stolen card, and now my account is flagged for fraud. I am being threatened with suspension. I need the finance department to verify the payment source and clear my name before the hearing tomorrow.

Excess fee payment for the lab component. I accidentally added an extra zero and paid 50,000 instead of 5,000. My parents are extremely upset as this was for our home rent. I need the 45,000 refunded to the source account within 24 hours.

The university's online payment server is down on the last day of fee submission. Thousands of us are trying to pay but getting 404 errors. If the deadline isn't extended by tonight, we will all be hit with late fines. Please confirm the extension or fix the server.

Missing mess-off refund from the previous break. I stayed home for a month during the holidays and filed the paperwork, but the credit isn't showing. I need that 3,000 to pay for my current month's food bill or I'll be barred from the mess hall tonight.

Tuition waiver not applied to my profile. As a staff-child, I am entitled to a 50% discount, but the portal shows the full amount of 1.2 lakhs. The payment link expires this evening. I need the corrected invoice before I can make the payment.

Bank challan not accepted at the counter. I stood in line for three hours only to be told the format changed this morning. No one informed the students. I have the cash and the old form, and today is the deadline. Please accept the payment or provide a grace period.

Emergency refund needed for medical withdrawal. My brother is undergoing surgery and I need to withdraw my admission to support my family. Today is the final eligibility day for a full refund. If this isn't processed today, I lose 2 lakhs. Please expedite the file.

Finance office lost my original demand draft. I submitted it last week for the exam fee and have the receipt, but now they say they can't find it and I need to pay again or I won't be allowed in the exam hall. I cannot afford to pay twice. Please find the DD or accept my receipt as proof.

System error: Scholarship adjusted against the wrong semester. The 20,000 grant was supposed to cover this semester's tuition, but it was applied to a future semester instead. Now I have a 'Due' of 20,000 and I am being blocked from the library. Please fix the allocation today.

The ATM inside the campus swallowed my card while I was trying to withdraw fee money. The bank branch says they need an official letter from the University Finance Head to release the machine logs and give me my card back. I need this today as all my funds are tied to that account.

Request for a breakdown of the 'General Amenities' fee. Every year we pay 15,000 for this but there is no transparency on what it covers. The gym is broken and the common rooms are dusty. We would like an itemized list of where this money is being spent before the next installment is due.

The fee receipt generated by the portal is missing the university seal. I need to submit this to my father's office for his HRA and education allowance, but they rejected the current PDF. Can the finance department provide a digitally signed version with the official stamp?

Delay in refunding the caution money for passed-out students. It has been three months since I submitted my bank details for the 10,000 security deposit return. All my batchmates have received theirs but mine is still 'In Process'. Please check the status of my application.

The 'Pay in Installments' option is not appearing on my dashboard. I was told that students with financial difficulties could opt for a 3-part payment plan, but my portal only shows 'Full Payment'. I have already submitted my income certificate to the warden. Please enable the option.

Discrepancy in the fine calculation for late book return. The library says I owe 450, but the finance portal is showing 1,200. I have the return slips showing the actual dates. The accounts branch needs to sync the data with the library system to reflect the correct amount.

Scholarship status remains 'Pending' for over a month. I've submitted all the documents for the state scholarship, but the university hasn't forwarded my application to the government portal yet. If this delay continues, the government portal will close. Please expedite the verification.

The fee payment history on my student profile is incomplete. It shows payments for the 1st and 3rd years, but the 2nd-year data is missing even though I have the physical receipts. This could cause issues during my final clearance next semester. Can you update the digital record?

Inquiry regarding the 'Development Fee' hike. We noticed a 10% increase in the current semester's bill without any prior notice or explanation. As students, we would like to know the reason for this sudden change, especially since the campus facilities remain the same.

The ATM on campus has been 'Out of Cash' for three consecutive days. This is the only way for many of us to pay for small expenses and some of the smaller lab fees that are cash-only. Can the finance department coordinate with the bank to ensure it's refilled?

Need a duplicate copy of the first-semester fee challan. I lost my original file and the bank requires a copy to process my current loan top-up. The online portal doesn't show records that old. Can the accounts office issue a stamped duplicate this week?

Request to adjust excess mess fees against the next semester's tuition. I have a credit of 4,000 from the last semester and instead of a refund, I'd prefer it to be used to reduce my next bill. I was told I need a written request for this. Please confirm if this is approved.

The 'Finance Helpdesk' phone number is never answered. I have been calling for three days to ask about my scholarship status and it just rings or goes to voicemail. It’s very difficult for us to keep visiting the office during lecture hours just for small queries.

Inconsistency in the 'Convocation Fee' for regular vs. distance students. Some of my friends are being charged less for the same degree. We need a clear clarification on the pricing policy for the 2025 batch to ensure everyone is being billed fairly.

The online payment gateway charges a 2% convenience fee for credit cards. This adds up to nearly 2,000 rupees on a full semester bill. Are there any plans to introduce a zero-fee payment method like IMPS or a direct university bank transfer for the students?

Difficulty in generating a 'No Dues' certificate for a semester break. I am taking a medical leave and need to show I've cleared all finances. The portal says I have 'Library Dues' but the library says I'm clear. This cross-departmental sync is taking forever.

The 'Fee Structure' PDF on the website is outdated. It still shows the 2023 rates, which is confusing for those of us trying to plan our finances for the upcoming year. Can the accounts department upload the 2025-26 fee schedule as soon as possible?

Request for a formal letter from the finance office for an external scholarship. The NGO providing my funding needs a letter on university letterhead stating my total annual expenses. I have the format ready. When can I pick this up?

The 'Fine Waiver' request I submitted last week hasn't been processed. I was ill and couldn't pay the mess dues on time, and I provided a doctor's note to the accounts manager. The 500 late fine is still there. Can someone please review the case?

Duplicate entry in the 'Misc Fees' section. I've been billed for 'ID Card Replacement' twice this month even though I only requested it once and paid at the counter. Please remove the second charge of 250 from my outstanding balance.

Need clarification on the 'Alumni Fund' charge. I am only in my second year but I see a 1,000 rupee deduction for the alumni association. Is this an annual charge or a one-time thing? It wasn't mentioned in the original prospectus we received.

The bank branch inside the campus is understaffed. During the fee-payment week, the queues are so long that students are missing 2-3 lectures just to get a challan stamped. Can the finance office request the bank to open an extra counter during peak hours?

My 'Fee Receipt' shows the wrong course name. It says 'B.Sc' instead of 'B.Tech', which is causing issues with my education loan provider as they think I've changed my stream. I need a corrected receipt with the right department name.

The 'Direct Debit' setup for my monthly mess bill failed this month. I have enough balance in my account, so the issue might be on the university's end. I don't want to be hit with a late fine for a technical error. Please check the mandate status.

Request for a 'Fee Concession' form for siblings studying in the same university. My younger sister just joined the Architecture department and we were told there's a family discount. Where can we download the form and what are the required documents?

The finance portal doesn't allow for partial payments. I want to pay 20,000 now and the rest next week, but the gateway only allows the full amount to be entered. This is a problem for students who are waiting for their parents' salaries to be credited.

Inquiry about the 'Caution Money' interest. Since the university holds our 10,000 deposit for four years, we would like to know if that interest is used for student welfare or if it's credited back to us. This was a point of discussion in the last student council meeting.

The 'Late Fee' keeps increasing every day even though the bank was closed for a public holiday. We couldn't make the transfer because the servers were down and the branch was shut. We request a two-day extension on the grace period for the July batch.

My scholarship amount was credited but it's 2,000 less than the sanctioned amount. Is there a processing fee or a tax deduction that I wasn't aware of? I need an itemized statement of the disbursement for my personal records.

The 'Online Finance Portal' has a very confusing UI. It's hard to find where the previous semester's receipts are stored. A simple 'Download All' button for the yearly statements would be very helpful for our income tax filings.

Request to update the bank account details for my stipend. I have closed my old account and need the research grant to be sent to my new IDFC account from next month. I have the cancelled cheque and the bank passbook copy ready.

Inconsistency in the mess bill for vegetarians. I noticed that the monthly charge is the same for everyone, regardless of whether we opt for the non-veg special meals. Can we have a tiered billing system that reflects our actual consumption?

The 'No Dues' clearance for the sports department is not reflecting in the finance system. I returned all my equipment last Friday but my portal still shows an outstanding amount of 2,500. Please sync the records so I can register for exams.

I was charged a 'Convenience Fee' for an offline cash deposit at the bank. I thought these charges were only for online transactions. Can the finance branch clarify if this is a new policy for the current academic year?

Request for a fee estimate for the next academic year. I need to apply for a bank loan extension and they require an official projected cost for tuition and hostel. Who should I contact to get this document stamped?

Need an explanation for the 'Insurance Premium' deduction. I noticed a 500 rupee charge for student insurance but I never received any policy documents or details on what it covers. Can the accounts office send us the digital policy copy?

The ink on the printed fee receipts is very faint. By the time the semester ends, the text is almost invisible. It would be better if the finance office used higher-quality printers or gave us a digital copy alongside the physical one.

Suggestion for an 'Auto-Pay' feature for the monthly mess bills. It’s a bit of a hassle to log in every month just to pay a small amount. A recurring payment option through UPI or Net Banking would be a great convenience for everyone.

The lighting in the accounts office waiting area is a bit dim. When we are trying to fill out the challan forms, it’s hard to see the small text. Adding one or two extra lights would make the process much easier for us.

Could we have a 'Fee Calculator' on the university website? Sometimes it's hard to figure out the total amount including labs and electives. A simple tool where we select our branch and semester would be very useful.

The notice regarding the 'Exam Fee' was posted very late on the bulletin board. Most of us only saw it a day before the deadline. It would be better if these announcements were sent via SMS or app notification as well.

Request for a small table near the bank counter. Currently, there is nowhere to keep our bags or files while we are filling out the deposit slips. A simple standing desk would make the queue much more organized.

The 'Finance Section' on the student app is quite slow. It takes a long time to load the payment history. A quick optimization update for the mobile version of the portal would be appreciated by the student community.

Can the university start accepting international cards for the application fees? I have a foreign-exchange card from my travel and it would be easier to use that than to keep converting currency for small academic charges.

The 'Fee Payment' window is only open from 10 AM to 3 PM. Since most of us have labs during these hours, it’s hard to visit the office. Extending the window by just one hour until 4 PM would be a huge help.

The digital display showing the token numbers in the finance lobby is flickering. It makes it hard to know whose turn it is. It probably just needs a loose cable to be tightened or the screen replaced.

Suggestion to add a 'Frequently Asked Questions' section for scholarships on the portal. Many of us have the same questions about eligibility and deadlines, and a simple FAQ page would save a lot of time for the staff.

The water cooler near the finance office is often out of paper cups in the afternoon. Since students spend a lot of time waiting in line there, it would be nice if the supplies were restocked more frequently.

Can we have a separate 'Fast Track' line for students who just need to pick up a pre-printed receipt? Currently, everyone stands in the same queue regardless of whether they are paying or just collecting a document.

The 'Scholarship Notification' emails sometimes end up in the spam folder because of the sender's address. Maybe the university can use a more recognized domain so we don't miss out on important financial deadlines.

Request for a few more pens to be kept at the challan counter. Often there are none available and we have to keep asking other students. It’s a small thing but it would make the experience smoother for everyone.
The chairs in the finance waiting area are quite old and some are broken. Replacing them with a few rows of sturdy benches would provide more seating for the students during the busy admission weeks.
The 'Transaction Fee' for various online modes isn't clearly listed before we reach the final payment page. It would be better to see the comparison of charges upfront.

Suggestion for a digital 'Queue Management' system. Instead of standing in a physical line, we could get a token on our phones and come back when it’s our turn. This would prevent the hallway from getting overcrowded.
The 'Annual Report' on student welfare funds hasn't been posted in the lobby this year. We always like to see how the student activity fees are being utilized for campus events and sports equipment.
The staff at the 'Information Desk' in the finance wing are sometimes a bit curt when we ask about refund timelines. A bit more patience with our queries would be appreciated.
Can we have a small bin specifically for the discarded challan carbon copies near the bank? People usually just leave them on the desks, which makes the area look quite untidy by the end of the day.
The 'Help' icon on the payment portal is broken. When you click it, nothing happens. It would be good if it linked to a support email for students facing technical issues during payment.

Request for a few more ceiling fans in the accounts branch hallway. It gets very hot during the July fee submission week and the current ventilation isn't enough for the number of students standing in line.

The 'Fee Due' alerts on the mobile app are sent at 2 AM. It’s a bit startling to get a notification in the middle of the night. Scheduling these for during the day would be a much better user experience.
The 'Finance News' ticker on the lobby TV is moving too fast. It's almost impossible to read the scholarship dates before they scroll off the screen. Slowing it down by half would be very helpful.
Suggestion to allow 'Mobile Wallet' payments for the cafeteria and the small stationary shop on campus. Currently, they only take cash, which is a bit inconvenient for quick purchases.

The 'Scholarship Form' PDF is not editable. We have to print it out, fill it by hand, and then scan it again. Making it a fillable PDF form would be a much more modern and efficient way to handle the process.
Request to move the 'Fee Deposit' box to a more visible location. It’s currently hidden behind a pillar and many new students miss it and end up standing in the wrong line just to drop off a cheque.
The 'Transaction Receipt' we get via SMS doesn't include the student ID number. Adding that small detail would make it much easier to track the payment if there’s ever a dispute.
Can the university provide a small 'Finance Handbook' for the freshmen? It would be great to have all the bank details, payment dates, and refund policies in one place.

The 'No Dues' stamp used by the office is very blurry. It’s hard to read the date and signature on the final clearance form. Replacing the old rubber stamp with a new one would make the document look more official.

Request for a few more staplers at the document submission desk. Students often forget to staple their challans to their registration forms, leading to lost papers. A few fixed staplers would prevent this.
The 'Finance Section' website takes a long time to load on mobile browsers. Since many of us check our balance on the go, a 'lite' version of the site would be very useful.

Could the finance office post a 'Holiday List' on the main door? Sometimes we travel from far away only to find the bank and the accounts branch closed for a local festival. A clear schedule would save us the trip.
The carpet in the waiting area of the accounts office is quite worn out and has a few trip hazards. It might be time to replace it with some easy-to-clean tiling or a new rug.
Suggestion for a 'Feedback Box' specifically for the accounts department. It would be a nice way for students to share their experiences with the fee payment process and suggest improvements.

The 'Instruction' stickers on the ATM are peeling off. It’s hard to see which slot is for the card and which is for the receipt. A fresh set of stickers would make the machine easier to use for new students.
Can the finance office start sending 'Payment Successful' notifications via the university's official WhatsApp bot? It’s a more reliable way to keep a record than just relying on the website portal.

The 'Privacy Screen' on the finance office counters is a bit too opaque. It’s hard to hear the staff through the glass. A small speaking hole or an intercom system would make communication much better.
Request for a clock in the finance office waiting area. It helps us keep track of how long we’ve been waiting and ensures we don't miss our next lecture if the queue is moving slowly.

The main water pipe in the basement of Block B has burst and is flooding the server room. There is about two inches of water on the floor already and it is rising toward the power backup units. If the water hits the electrical mains, the entire building will short circuit. We need a plumbing team and a heavy-duty pump here immediately to prevent a total blackout and equipment damage.

Gas leak detected near the chemistry lab storage area. There is a very strong, distinct smell of LPG wafting into the corridor of the West Wing. This is an extreme fire hazard especially with students performing experiments nearby. I have evacuated the immediate area but we need a technician to shut off the main valve and check the pipes right now.

Elevator stuck between the 5th and 6th floors with four students inside. The emergency alarm is ringing but the lift car isn't moving and the fan has stopped working. One of the students is starting to panic due to the heat and lack of ventilation. We need the lift technician to manually override the system and rescue them before they run out of air.

Exposed high-voltage wires in the laundry room after the heavy rain. The insulation on the main dryer cable has frayed and is sparking near a puddle of water on the floor. Anyone walking in there to collect their clothes is at risk of electrocution. This area needs to be cordoned off and the power cut immediately for repairs.

Main entrance glass door shattered in the Girls Hostel. A heavy gust of wind slammed the door and it has broken into large sharp shards across the lobby. Since it is the ground floor entrance, anyone can enter the premises now and students are walking barefoot near the glass. We need an emergency cleanup and a temporary board installed for security.

Ceiling plaster fell on a student's bed in room 302 of the old wing. A large chunk of the roof collapsed this morning and the rest of the ceiling looks severely cracked and water-damaged. It is unsafe for the residents to stay in that room as another collapse is imminent. We need an immediate structural assessment and a room shift for the occupants.

Total power failure in the medical wing of the campus clinic. The backup generator is not kicking in and there are temperature-sensitive vaccines stored in the refrigerators. If the power isn't restored in the next hour, thousands of dollars worth of medication will be ruined. Please send an emergency electrician to bypass the faulty breaker.

Heavy sewage backup in the ground floor washrooms of Block C. Foul water is overflowing from the drains and entering the residential rooms. It is a massive health risk and the smell is becoming unbearable for the entire block. We need a professional drainage clearing team to address this blockage immediately.

Broken window latch on a ground floor room facing the main road. The lock snapped and the window can now be opened from the outside by anyone. This is a major security breach for the student living there, especially at night. I cannot leave my room unattended. Please send a carpenter to fix the latch before sunset.

Fire alarm system is malfunctioning and sounding continuously in Block D. It has been going off for 20 minutes but there is no fire. However, because it won't stop, students are ignoring it, which is dangerous if a real emergency occurs. We need the system reset and the faulty sensor replaced immediately.

Main gate of the faculty residential area is jammed and won't open. An ambulance is trying to get through for an emergency call but the electronic gates are unresponsive. We need someone to manually release the gears or cut the lock right now to allow the emergency vehicle through.

Large tree limb has fallen across the power lines near the cafeteria. The lines are sagging dangerously low and are humming loudly. If they snap, they will hit the crowded walkway below. Maintenance needs to clear the branch and secure the lines before someone gets hurt.

Smoke coming from the central air conditioning vent in the auditorium. During the seminar, we noticed a burning smell and grey smoke emitting from the ceiling units. We have turned off the AC but we need a technician to inspect the motor for a fire before the next session begins.

Structural crack widened significantly on the 2nd floor balcony. After the minor tremor last night, the gap in the concrete has doubled in size. We are worried about the balcony's weight-bearing capacity. Please cordon off the area and send a civil engineer to inspect the stability today.

Water tank overflow is flooding the stairwell of Block E. The float valve has failed and hundreds of gallons of water are cascading down the stairs, making them extremely slippery. This is wasting a massive amount of water and creating a fall hazard for everyone in the building.

Basement flooding near the main circuit breakers. Rainwater is seeping through the foundation and pooling around the electrical panels. If the water level rises another inch, it will trigger a mass short circuit. We need sandbags and a suction pump here now.

Corroded railing on the 4th-floor terrace has snapped. A student leaned on it and a section of the metal gave way. Thankfully they didn't fall, but that entire side of the roof is now unprotected. This needs to be welded or replaced urgently before tonight.

The emergency exit door in the library is jammed shut. In case of a fire, people on the second floor would be trapped as the main stairs would be the only exit. This is a serious safety violation. The door needs to be unjammed and the hinges lubricated today.

Steam pipe leak in the mess kitchen. A high-pressure valve has started leaking hot steam near the cooking vats. It is too dangerous for the staff to prepare dinner. We need a mechanical technician to replace the valve so the kitchen can resume operations.

Unstable scaffolding left by the painting crew. The metal structure near the entrance is swaying in the wind and looks like it might tip over onto the student walkway. It needs to be secured or dismantled immediately before it causes an accident.

Chemical spill in the basement storage room. A shelf collapsed and several containers of industrial cleaning agents have leaked and are reacting. There are localized fumes and we need a hazmat-trained maintenance member to neutralize the spill.

The main boiler has reached critical pressure levels. The gauge is in the red and the pressure release valve isn't popping. We need a boiler technician to bleed the system immediately to prevent a rupture in the basement.

Bees nest in the air vent of room 412. Swarms of bees are entering the room through the AC duct and my roommate has already been stung twice. She is allergic to stings. We need an exterminator and the duct sealed before we can re-enter the room.

Sinkhole appearing in the parking lot. A section of the asphalt has collapsed near the drain and is about three feet deep. It is right in the path of incoming cars. We need it cordoned off and filled before a vehicle falls in.

The overhead water tank lid has blown off in the storm. Birds and debris are falling into our drinking water supply. This is an immediate hygiene issue for the 200 residents of this block. Please secure the lid or install a new one today.

The air conditioning in the computer lab is not cooling properly. With 40 students and all the machines running, the temperature is reaching 30 degrees. It is becoming very difficult to focus on our coding lab. The filters probably need cleaning or the gas needs a refill.

Persistent dampness on the wall of room 215. Ever since the rains started, a large wet patch has appeared and mold is starting to grow. It smells very musty and is affecting my breathing at night. We need a waterproofing specialist to check the exterior wall.

One of the four burners in the hostel pantry is not working. The ignition sparks but the flame won't catch, so there is always a faint smell of gas when someone tries to use it. It makes cooking very slow during the evening rush. Please have it serviced.

The communal shower in the North Wing has a very weak flow. It takes forever to get the soap off because the water just trickles out. We think the showerhead is clogged with lime scale. Could maintenance replace the head or descale the pipes this week?

Squeaky ceiling fan in the study hall. The fan in the corner makes a loud metallic grinding noise whenever it's on speed 3 or higher. It is very distracting for everyone trying to study in silence. A simple oiling of the motor should fix the issue.

The hallway lights on the 3rd floor of Block G have been dead for three days. It is pitch black at night and we have to use our phone torches to find our room keys. It’s a safety issue for the students. Please replace the tube lights or check the starter.

Slow drainage in the mess washbasin. Every time we wash our hands before lunch, the water pools up and takes 10 minutes to go down. It's getting quite dirty and leaves a lot of residue. The 'U-bend' under the sink likely needs to be cleared of debris.

The door closer in the library is too tight. The door slams shut with a loud bang every time someone enters, which is constant. It disrupts the quiet environment and might eventually break the glass. Please adjust the hydraulic tension on the arm.

Exhaust fan in the bathroom is not rotating. The room stays very humid and the mirrors are constantly fogged up, which is leading to more mold on the tiles. I’ve checked the switch but the motor seems to be burnt out. Requesting a replacement.

The floor tiles in the lobby are loose. Several of the large marble tiles near the reception desk wobble when you step on them. Someone is going to trip if they aren't re-cemented soon. This has been an issue for over a week now.

Window pane is vibrating loudly during high winds. The glass in room 504 seems to have come loose from the putty or the frame. It makes a very annoying rattling sound all night. Can maintenance apply some sealant to stop the vibration?

The gym treadmill has a frayed belt. It’s starting to slip when you run at higher speeds, which could cause someone to fall off. The machine is otherwise fine, but the belt definitely needs to be replaced before it snaps completely.

Pest control needed for the common room. We have seen cockroaches and silverfish near the sofas and under the TV cabinet. It’s getting a bit unhygienic for us to sit there and eat snacks. Please schedule a professional spray for the weekend.

The water cooler in the faculty block is leaking. There is a constant puddle of water on the wooden floor which is starting to warp the planks. It looks like the internal drainage pipe is disconnected. Please fix the leak to save the flooring.

Broken towel rack in the washroom. The metal bar has come off the wall on one side because the screws have pulled out of the drywall. I have no place to hang my clothes while showering. Can maintenance re-install it with better anchors?

The clock in the main hallway is stuck. It’s been showing 10:15 for two days. It’s a small thing but it’s the only clock we have to check if we are on time for our lectures. Please replace the battery or the unit.

Bicycle rack is rusting and one of the bars has snapped. It has a sharp edge that could scratch someone's leg or puncture a tire. It needs a quick weld and a fresh coat of anti-rust paint to make it usable again.

Request for better weather stripping on the balcony door. During the rain yesterday, water seeped under the door and soaked my rug. A simple rubber strip at the bottom of the door would prevent this from happening again.

The paint is peeling off the radiator in my room. The old flakes are falling onto my bed and it looks very untidy. Since the radiator is still working, it just needs a quick scrape and a heat-resistant touch-up before the winter starts.

Automatic hand dryer in the cafeteria is not sensing anything. It stays off even when you put your hands directly under it. This leads to people using a lot of paper towels, which is wasteful. Please check the IR sensor.

Loose door handle on the seminar room. You have to jiggle it several times to get it to latch properly. Sometimes students get 'locked in' for a few seconds because it won't turn. It just needs the internal screws tightened.

The outdoor benches in the courtyard are splintering. The wood has weathered poorly and it’s impossible to sit on them without catching your clothes or getting a splinter. They need to be sanded down and revarnished for the students.

The water pressure in the bidet spray is way too high. It’s almost painful to use and it splashes water everywhere in the stall. Could the plumber adjust the pressure valve for the ground floor washrooms?

Intermittent buzzing from the fluorescent lights in LT-1. One of the ballasts is failing and the constant hum is making it hard to hear the professor's voice clearly. Can maintenance replace the faulty ballast after classes end?

The lock on the post-box is jammed. I can't get my mail out because the key won't turn in the cylinder. I’ve tried using some oil but it didn't help. I need a locksmith or the maintenance team to open it and replace the lock.

The privacy screen in the girls' shower area is torn. It’s a thick plastic curtain but the rings have pulled through the top. It provides very little privacy now. Requesting a new heavy-duty curtain to be installed.

Stairwell railing is loose between the 3rd and 4th floors. The metal pipe wobbles when you hold it for support. This is a safety concern for anyone carrying heavy books or laundry. Please tighten the wall brackets.

The microwave in the student pantry is not heating food evenly. One side of the plate stays cold while the other is boiling. It might be the rotating base or the magnetron failing. Can we have it checked by an appliance technician?

Dust accumulation in the AC vents of the reading room. Whenever the air turns on, it blows out a cloud of dust that triggers my allergies. The vents haven't been vacuumed in a long time. Please schedule a cleaning of the duct covers.

The mirror in the washroom has developed black spots. It looks like the silvering is coming off from the back due to the moisture. It makes it very hard to see clearly. It’s time for a new mirror to be fitted.

One of the stalls in the men's room has a broken latch. You have to hold the door with one hand while using the facility. This has been broken for a month. A simple sliding bolt would fix this easily.

The water dispenser is making a loud vibrating noise. Every time it chills the water, the whole unit rattles against the wall. It’s very annoying for the students in the adjacent study room. Please check the compressor mounts.

The window mesh in room 108 is torn. Mosquitoes are getting in at night even when the glass is closed because the screen is loose. I would appreciate it if maintenance could replace the mesh with a new one.

Request for a doorstopper in the common room. The door keeps swinging shut because of the draft, and then people have to keep opening it. A simple wedge or a floor-mounted stopper would be a great addition.

The floor boards in the old music room are creaking loudly. Every time someone walks across the floor, it makes a piercing sound. We think some of the nails have come loose. Can maintenance secure the loose planks?

The paint in the study room is a bit scuffed. It’s not a major issue, but the walls look a bit dirty from where chairs have rubbed against them. A fresh coat of white paint would make the room feel much brighter and cleaner.

The door handle to the terrace is a bit stiff. It works fine, but you have to use a bit more force than usual to turn it. A quick spray of WD-40 on the mechanism would probably make it move smoothly again.

Request for more coat hooks in the individual study carrels. Currently, there is nowhere to hang a jacket or a bag, so they end up on the floor. Adding two small hooks to each booth would be a very helpful upgrade.

The signage for the different wings is starting to fade. New students are getting confused because the 'Block B' sign is hard to read from the entrance. It would be nice to have them repainted or replaced with bolder text.

Could we have a few more mats at the entrance of the hostel? During the rainy season, the existing ones get soaked very quickly and then people just track mud into the hallway. Two extra rubber mats would help keep the floors clean.

The clock in the cafeteria is five minutes slow. It’s not a big deal, but it does cause some confusion for students trying to get to their 1 PM lectures on time. It just needs to be synced with the digital campus clock.
One of the legs on the common room coffee table is slightly uneven. It wobbles just a little bit when you put a drink on it. A small felt pad under the short leg would easily fix the balance.
The window handles in the seminar hall are a bit dusty. It looks like they were missed during the last cleaning round. A quick wipe-down with a damp cloth is all they need to look new again.

Suggestion for a small 'Lost and Found' shelf near the maintenance office. People often find keys or small tools and don't know where to drop them off. A designated wooden shelf would be very useful for the community.

The lighting in the laundry room is a bit 'yellow'. Switching to a cool white LED would make it much easier to see if there are any stains left on our white lab coats. It’s a minor preference but it would help.

The door to the pantry makes a slight squeak when it opens. It’s not loud enough to bother most people, but a drop of oil on the hinges would make the environment a bit quieter during late-night study sessions.

Request for a bulletin board in the maintenance hallway. We currently tape all our repair requests to the door, which leaves sticky residue. A proper cork board would be a much tidier way to manage the notices.

The trash cans in the courtyard don't have lids. This means that sometimes the wind blows lighter pieces of paper back onto the grass. Switching to bins with flap lids would keep the area looking much neater.
The floor in the gym area has a few scuff marks from where the weights were moved. It doesn't affect the usage, but a good buffing or a deep clean would make the facility look much more professional.
Could we have a few more plants in the lobby area? It’s a bit stark at the moment and some greenery would make the maintenance office entrance look much more welcoming for the students.
The stapler at the reception desk is always running out of pins. It would be great if the maintenance staff could keep a small box of staples nearby so students don't have to keep asking around.
The handrails in the stairwell are a bit sticky. It seems like something was spilled on them recently. A quick cleaning with some disinfectant would make them much more pleasant to use.
The 'Maintenance' sign on the office door is slightly crooked. It’s a very minor aesthetic issue, but leveling it out would give a better impression of the department's attention to detail.

Suggestion to add a 'Suggestion Box' for infrastructure improvements. We often have ideas for small things like better bike racks or extra benches, and a box would be a great way to collect those thoughts.
The water pressure in the water fountain near the gym is a bit low. It’s hard to fill up a large bottle quickly. It’s not a major problem, but a small adjustment to the valve would be appreciated.

The blinds in the computer lab have a small cord that is fraying. They still work fine for now, but the cord might snap in a few months. It would be good to replace it before it becomes a real problem.
The paint on the courtyard benches is starting to look a bit dull. A fresh coat of varnish next semester would help protect the wood from the sun and keep them looking nice for the students.
Request for a few more mirrors in the common washrooms. Currently, there is only one for four sinks, which causes a bit of a queue in the morning. Adding two more would speed up our morning routine.
The digital clock in the lobby has a very bright blue display that is a bit piercing at night. If there’s a way to dim it or switch it to a softer color like red or amber, it would be much better.
One of the tiles in the shower area has a small chip. It’s not sharp enough to cut anyone, but it’s a bit of an eyesore. Filling it with a bit of white grout would make the floor look perfect again.
The doorstop in room 204 has come loose. The rubber part fell off so the door hits the wall now. It just needs to be screwed back in or replaced with a new one to prevent wall damage.
Could the maintenance team check the alignment of the lockers in Block C? Some of them are slightly slanted, which makes the whole row look a bit disorganized. It’s a very minor structural fix.
The 'Caution: Wet Floor' signs are looking a bit dirty. Since they are used in the main lobby, it would be good to give them a scrub so they look professional and are clearly visible to everyone.
Request for a small rack for wet umbrellas at the entrance of the maintenance wing. It would stop people from bringing dripping umbrellas inside and making the floor slippery for the staff.
The lighting in the back corner of the study hall is a bit dim for reading textbooks. Replacing the 40W bulb with a 60W one would make it a much more usable space for late-night sessions.
The door to the storage room has a few old stickers on it that are half-peeled. Removing them and cleaning the adhesive would make the hallway look much tidier and more official.
Suggestion to add a few more 'No Smoking' signs in the garden area. Some people are ignoring the current ones because they are small. Larger, clearer signs would help enforce the campus policy.
The sink in the pantry has a small scratch in the stainless steel. It doesn't affect the function at all, but using a bit of metal polish might help minimize the appearance of the mark.
Request for more frequent weeding of the small flower beds near the hostel entrance. A few weeds are starting to poke through the mulch and it would look much nicer if they were pulled.
The power outlets in the common room are a bit loose in the wall. They work fine, but they wiggle a bit when you plug in a charger. Tightening the faceplate screws would solve the issue.
The 'Exit' sign over the side door is slightly dim. It’s still readable, but it might need a new bulb soon to stay compliant with the safety regulations for the building.

The 'Library' sign in the East Wing has a slightly loose bracket. It’s not in danger of falling yet, but it rattles a bit when the AC kicks in. Tightening the two screws on the side would make it perfectly stable again.

Request to reposition the trash bin in the common area by a few feet. Currently, it’s placed right under the light switch, which makes it a bit awkward to reach for the button in the dark. Moving it to the corner would be a better layout.

The whiteboards in the student lounge have some ghosting from old markers. A standard cleaning spray doesn't seem to work. Could the maintenance staff provide a bottle of professional board restorer for us to use?"

The door to the faculty restroom has a coat of paint that is slightly uneven near the bottom. It's a very minor aesthetic flaw that probably occurred during the last touch-up. Re-sanding and a quick thin coat would smooth it out.

The morning shuttle at 8:30 AM is always completely packed. Many students are forced to stand right next to the driver's seat or wait for the next one, which makes them late for their first lecture. It would be great if an extra bus could be added for this specific slot.

I think it would be a good idea to put a bench at the North Gate pickup point. There is currently nowhere to sit while waiting for the loop bus, which is a bit of a hassle when you're carrying heavy books or a laptop bag.

The 9:00 PM shuttle driver was driving incredibly fast through the pedestrian zone near the library. I almost got hit while crossing. This kind of reckless behavior is terrifying and someone is going to get seriously hurt if this isn't addressed immediately.

I'm currently stranded at the campus perimeter because the 5:00 PM bus never showed up and I have a final exam starting in 15 minutes. There's no other way to get to the hall on time. Please help me get there before the doors close.

For the third day in a row, the AC in bus number 12 isn't working. It’s nearly 40 degrees outside and the cabin is like an oven. It’s very difficult to focus on my notes when I'm sweating through my clothes before I even reach the department.

My student ID card isn't being recognized by the scanner on the Blue Route buses. Every time I board, I have to explain the situation to the driver which holds up the line. I’ve already been to the admin office and they said the card is fine, so it must be the bus scanners.

Can we get a digital tracker for the shuttle? Sometimes the bus arrives five minutes early and we miss it, and other times it's ten minutes late and we're just standing there wondering if it's coming at all.
The stairs on the 42nd Street bus are becoming loose and wobbly. I saw a student trip and nearly fall off the vehicle this morning. This needs to be fixed before the metal completely gives way.

I noticed that the bike racks on the front of the campus shuttles are often full. Maybe we could look into installing a few more racks so more people are encouraged to cycle instead of taking their cars?

The evening route home is consistently skipping the stop near the Engineering block. We wait there for ages and watch the bus go by on the main road without turning in. This has happened four times this week and it's very frustrating.
I left my blue umbrella on the 2:15 PM shuttle today. I sat near the back. If the driver found it, could you let me know where I can go to pick it up?

The shuttle driver was using his phone to watch videos while driving the highway stretch between campuses. He was barely looking at the road and drifting between lanes. I felt completely unsafe and had to get off early.

There’s a strange burning smell coming from the engine of the morning bus that runs through the South campus. It’s been happening for a few days now and it makes me worried about the vehicle's maintenance.
The weekend shuttle schedule is very confusing. The timings posted on the website don't match the actual times the bus arrives. Could the PDF be updated to reflect the current routes?
During the rain yesterday, the roof of the bus was leaking right over the middle seats. My bag and laptop got soaked. This is a basic maintenance issue that shouldn't be happening.
Someone spilled coffee all over the back row of the 10:00 AM shuttle and it's still there, sticky and smelling bad. It would be nice if the interiors were cleaned more frequently during the day.

The driver of the midday loop was incredibly rude to an international student today. He shouted at her because she didn't understand how the pass system worked. It was very unprofessional and made everyone on the bus uncomfortable.
Is there any way to extend the shuttle service by one hour on Friday nights? Many of us stay late at the lab and having to walk back to the dorms in the dark feels unsafe.

The brakes on the bus ending in plate 442 are screeching very loudly every time it stops. It sounds like the pads are completely worn out and it's quite alarming to hear when the bus is full of people.

I’ve noticed the shuttle stops aren't very well lit at night. As a student who works late shifts at the library, waiting at the North stop feels very sketchy. Installing even one small light would make a big difference for safety.

Why does the bus driver always take a 20-minute break at the student center? It’s right in the middle of the route and it makes everyone late for their next class. Can the shift changes happen at the terminus instead?

I lost my wallet on the bus this morning. It’s a brown leather one with my license and some cash. If it’s been turned in, please let me know. I really need those IDs back for my internship interview tomorrow.
The 8:00 AM bus simply didn't show up today. A group of about 30 of us were left waiting and most of us missed our mid-term presentations. We need a more reliable service for morning peak hours.
The bus stop sign near the gymnasium has fallen over. It’s lying in the grass and new students don't know where to stand to catch the shuttle.

There was a physical altercation between two students on the bus this afternoon and the driver didn't do anything to intervene or call security. It was a very scary environment and I didn't feel safe staying on the vehicle.

The shuttle route is too long. By the time it reaches the outskirts of the campus, it's already 40 minutes into the trip. Maybe splitting it into two smaller loops would be more efficient for everyone.

I noticed that the handicap ramp on the main campus bus is broken. A student in a wheelchair couldn't board today and had to wait for the next bus, which also had a faulty ramp. This is a major accessibility issue.
I'm very upset because the driver closed the doors right in my face even though he saw me running. I was only two feet away. Now I'm going to be late for my lab and my grade will be docked.
The bus windows are so dirty you can barely see out of them. It's hard to know which stop we're at, especially when it's dark outside. A simple wash once a week would help.

The 11:00 PM shuttle stop is located in a very isolated area with no CCTV. I saw someone suspicious hanging around there last night and I think the stop should be moved closer to the well-lit main road for student safety.
Every time the bus hits a pothole, the entire overhead rack rattles like it's going to fall off. It's very distracting when trying to read.
The shuttle service keeps changing the route without updating the app. I waited for an hour today at a stop that apparently isn't being used anymore. Please communicate these changes better.
There is a huge crack in the windshield of the bus that does the inter-campus run. It’s right in the driver’s line of sight and seems like a major safety hazard if a rock hits it.
Could we have more frequent buses during finals week? The library is packed 24/7 and the current shuttle frequency isn't enough to handle the number of students leaving at 2:00 AM.
The driver was smoking inside the bus while waiting at the terminus. The whole cabin smelled like cigarettes when we boarded, which is gross and also against campus policy.
The morning bus is consistently 15 minutes late. If this continues, I'm going to have to start paying for Ubers because I can't keep missing the start of my 9:00 AM seminar.
I accidentally dropped my keys down the gap in the folding doors of the bus. I need them to get into my apartment tonight. Is there any way for maintenance to check the door mechanism?
The bus was so overcrowded today that students were literally pressed against the doors. If the driver had to brake suddenly, those doors could have given way. This is a disaster waiting to happen.
I’d like to suggest adding a "request stop" button to the older buses. Right now you have to shout to the driver or pull a string that doesn't always work.
The heater on the bus is stuck on full blast. It’s already warm outside and we're all suffocating in there. The driver says he can't turn it off because the knob is broken.
I saw a group of non-students using the shuttle to get across town. This made the bus too full for actual students who pay for this service through their fees. There should be an ID check.
The driver started driving before a student with crutches had a chance to sit down. She fell over and hit her head. We need drivers who are more mindful of students with mobility issues.
The 4:00 PM shuttle route takes a very long detour through the construction site. It adds 15 minutes to the trip for no reason. Is there a more direct path available?
My bus pass was overcharged this month. I usually pay for the student discount rate but the system took the full faculty amount. I need a refund of the difference.
I witnessed a student being harassed by a group of people on the late-night shuttle. The driver didn't notice because he had headphones in. We need better monitoring on the night routes.
The seats in the back of the bus are ripped and the foam is coming out. It looks terrible and makes the whole campus look bad to visitors.

The bus driver refused to let me on with my project model, even though it wasn't that big. I had to walk 20 minutes in the wind and it got damaged. I don't understand why there isn't a clearer policy on luggage.
I missed my flight home because the airport shuttle provided by the university broke down on the highway and no backup was sent for two hours. I had to buy a new ticket which cost me $300.
Can we have a lost and found section on the transport website? It would be much easier than calling the office every time someone loses a hat or a glove.
The bus driver was being very aggressive with his horn and yelling at other drivers in traffic. It was very embarrassing and made the university look bad.
The shuttle at 7:30 AM is always empty. Maybe that resource could be moved to the 10:00 AM slot when the buses are overflowing?
I think I left my phone on the seat of the Green Line bus. It's a black iPhone. If anyone finds it, please call the admin office. I need it for my multi-factor authentication for my exams.
The bus stop signs are fading and you can't read the route numbers anymore. It would be helpful to have them repainted or replaced.
The driver missed the turn for the East dorms and refused to go back. He told us we had to walk from the next stop, which is over a mile away, in the dark.
I feel like the drivers need more training on how to operate the new electric buses. They are very jerky with the brakes and it makes a lot of people feel motion sick.
The 3:00 PM shuttle is always 10 minutes late, which means I miss my connection to the city bus. Could the schedule be adjusted to be more realistic?
There was a large dog on the bus today that wasn't a service animal. It was barking at people and made many students uncomfortable. Aren't pets supposed to be in carriers?
I am writing to report a driver who was making inappropriate comments to female students as they boarded the bus. This is a huge safety and harassment issue and needs to be handled immediately.
The bus schedule on the mobile app is completely different from the one printed at the bus stop. Which one are we supposed to follow?
I had a flat tire on my bike and tried to use the bus, but the bike rack was broken and wouldn't lock. I had to leave my bike behind and now it's been stolen.
The 8:00 AM bus broke down on the main bridge and we were stuck there for 45 minutes. I missed my 8:30 AM quiz which is 10% of my grade. Is there any way to get a formal note for my professor?
The floor of the bus is extremely slippery when it rains. I saw several people almost wipe out today. Maybe some non-slip mats could be installed near the doors?
I noticed that the shuttle doesn't run during the spring break. Some of us stay on campus to work or study and it's very hard to get around without the buses.
The bus driver almost hit a cyclist because he didn't check his blind spot before turning into the campus gate. He didn't even stop to see if the guy was okay.
There is a lot of litter on the night buses. It would be great if there were small trash cans installed near the exits so people don't just leave their bottles on the floor.
The bus driver keeps skipping the stop at the medical center. He says no one is ever there, but I've been there twice this week and had to wave him down frantically just to get him to stop.
Is there a way to track the shuttle's carbon emissions? It would be a cool project for our environmental science class if that data was made public.
The emergency exit handle on bus 309 looks like it's been tampered with. It's hanging by a thread and might fall off, which seems like a major safety violation.
The shuttle route is very bumpy near the construction site. It’s hard to write or work on a laptop during the commute. Could the path be rerouted slightly?
I was overcharged for my parking permit this semester. I was supposed to get the early bird discount but the system charged me the full price.
The driver was driving with the door open while the bus was moving. A student was standing right there and could have easily fallen out. This is a total disregard for safety.
The bus stop at the stadium doesn't have a roof. When it's raining, we all get soaked while waiting for the shuttle. A simple shelter would be amazing.
The bus driver told me I couldn't board because the bus was "full," but I could clearly see several empty seats in the back. I think he just wanted to leave early.
Someone left a bag of groceries on the bus. There are perishables like milk and eggs in there. It’s been sitting there since the 11:00 AM run.
I missed my graduation ceremony because the special event shuttle never arrived at the designated parking lot. I am beyond devastated and want to know why there was no backup plan.
The seats on the new buses are very narrow. It’s quite uncomfortable when the bus is full and you're squeezed in between two other people.
My bus pass stopped working after I put it near my phone. Is there a way to get a replacement without paying the $20 fee since it's just a technical error?
The driver of the afternoon shuttle was yelling at a student for asking a simple question about the route. It was very aggressive and uncalled for.
The bus stop at the North End is obscured by overgrown bushes. Drivers can't see students waiting there and often drive right past.
There was a group of people drinking alcohol on the bus last night. They were being loud and spilling drinks on the seats. The driver didn't seem to care.
The shuttle frequency during the summer term is way too low. Waiting 40 minutes for a bus when it's 100 degrees outside is miserable.
I found a set of car keys on the 9:00 AM bus. They have a Toyota keychain. I gave them to the driver, just letting the office know in case someone calls.
The 5:30 PM bus is always late because of the traffic at the main intersection. Maybe the route could be changed to avoid that light?
The driver didn't wait for me to get off the bus and closed the door on my arm. I have a huge bruise and it really hurts. This is incredibly dangerous.
I was waiting for the bus for 30 minutes and then two buses arrived at the exact same time. This happens almost every day. The spacing needs to be better.
The bus stop near the library is always full of trash. It would be nice if there was a bigger bin there that got emptied more often.
I saw a student's backpack get caught in the bus door as it was pulling away. The driver didn't notice until we all started screaming. We need better sensors on those doors.
The shuttle service to the off-campus housing is very unreliable. Sometimes it comes, sometimes it doesn't. We pay a lot for this and expect better.
Can we get some posters on the bus about basic etiquette? Like letting people off before boarding and not playing music without headphones.
The bus driver was speeding in a school zone near the campus daycare. There were kids everywhere and he was going at least 40 in a 20 zone.
The AC in the bus is so cold that I have to bring a jacket even when it's hot outside. Can the temperature be set to something more reasonable?
The bus driver missed my stop even though I pulled the cord well in advance. When I told him, he just shrugged and told me to get off at the next one.
I left my lab notebook on the bus yesterday. It has all my data for my thesis. I am desperate to find it. Please let me know if it’s in the lost and found.
The shuttle stop at the student union is always crowded and there's no clear line. It’s just a mass of people shoving to get on. We need some railings to organize the queue.
The 6:00 PM bus is consistently overcrowded. People are standing in the stairwells which is a safety risk. We need a larger bus for this time slot.
The bus driver was making very sharp turns and several people fell out of their seats. He's driving like he's in a race, not carrying students.
Is there a way to get a shuttle to the train station on Friday afternoons? A lot of us go home for the weekend and it would be much easier than taking a taxi.
The bus driver refused to lower the bus for an elderly visitor who was struggling to get up the steps. It was very heartless and unnecessary.
The 7:00 AM bus has a very loud engine noise that sounds like something is rattling around inside. It’s been like this for a month.
I missed my final project submission because the bus driver took a wrong turn and got stuck in a dead-end street for 30 minutes. My professor won't accept the late work.
I noticed that the lock on the side door of the humanities building doesn't click shut properly. Anyone can just walk in without swiping their ID card, even after hours.
There is a group of people at the library entrance who are being very loud and making it hard to study. They’ve been there for two hours and don't seem to be students.

Help! A fight just broke out in the courtyard between two guys and one of them looks like he’s seriously hurt. There is blood on the pavement and nobody is stepping in to stop it. Please send someone right now!
I think I left my wallet in the cafeteria around 12:30 PM. It’s a small black cardholder with my student ID and some cash. If anyone turned it in, please let me know.

Someone has been following me from the lab to my dorm for the past three nights. They stay about twenty feet back and hide whenever I turn around. I’m terrified to walk home alone tonight and I'm currently hiding in the lobby.

My bike was stolen from the racks outside the science block. I locked it at 9:00 AM and when I came back at 3:00 PM, the lock was cut and the bike was gone. This is the second time this month I've seen a cut lock there.
I’d like to suggest putting more mirrors in the corners of the parking garage stairwells. It’s very hard to see if someone is coming around the bend and it feels a bit sketchy at night.

Someone is currently trying to kick down the door of my dorm room. I’m locked inside and I don't know who it is but they are screaming threats. Please get here fast, I think the wood is starting to splinter.
There are students smoking in the non-smoking zone near the gymnasium. The smoke drifts right into the vents and makes the whole locker room smell. It’s a violation of the campus health code.

I witnessed a student being harassed and bullied by a group near the fountain. They were filming it and laughing while the person was crying. It didn’t look like a joke at all and felt very malicious.

My laptop was taken from my desk in the library when I went to the restroom for five minutes. I have my final thesis on there and no backup. Is there any way to check the camera footage for that floor?

There is a very suspicious bag left unattended under the bench at the main bus stop. It’s been there for over an hour and I haven't seen anyone claim it. Given the current safety protocols, I thought I should report it.
Can we get more regular patrols around the back of the auditorium? It’s very dark back there and I’ve seen people who don't look like students hanging out and drinking late at night.
I saw some graffiti on the wall of the new arts building. It looks like it was done with permanent marker. It would be good to get it cleaned off before more people add to it.
I am trapped in the elevator in the Engineering block. The emergency button isn't working and it’s starting to get really hot in here. I’ve been stuck for 20 minutes and I'm starting to panic.
Someone is selling what looks like exam answer keys in the student lounge. They are charging fifty dollars and targeting freshmen. This seems like a major breach of academic integrity.
The streetlights on the path leading to the North dorms are all flickering or completely out. It’s pitch black at night and I’ve seen people tripping on the uneven pavement.
I found a set of keys near the sports field. They have a "Class of 2024" keychain. I've left them with the front desk but wanted to make sure there's a record in case the owner calls.
I just saw someone climb through a window on the first floor of the girls' hostel. They were wearing a hoodie and definitely didn't look like they lived there. This happened about two minutes ago.
My roommate is bringing unauthorized guests into our room every single night and they stay until 4:00 AM. It’s making it impossible for me to sleep or study, and it’s against our housing contract.
There’s a drone flying very low near the dormitory windows. It feels like a huge invasion of privacy as it’s clearly recording inside the rooms. Can we have a policy on drone usage over living areas?
I was just mugged at knifepoint behind the cafeteria. The person took my phone and my bag and ran towards the woods. I’m shaken up but not physically injured. Please send help.
Someone has been scratching cars in the faculty parking lot. I found a long key mark on my passenger door this afternoon. This is the third car I've seen with similar damage this week.
I’d like to report a broken window in the basement of the old library. It looks like someone threw a rock through it. It’s a safety hazard because of the glass on the floor.
There is a massive party happening in Room 402 of Block B. There are at least 50 people in a room meant for four, and they are throwing bottles off the balcony. Someone is going to get hit.
I suspect my lab partner is stealing chemicals from the supply closet. I saw them putting glass vials into their backpack when they thought I wasn't looking. This is dangerous and illegal.

The emergency blue light phone near the lake doesn't seem to be working. I tried to test it because the light was out, and there was no dial tone or response. This is a major safety risk if someone is in trouble.
Could we have a workshop on basic self-defense for students? With the recent increase in petty thefts around campus, I think a lot of people would feel more confident if they knew some basic moves.
Someone is using a fake ID to get into the campus bar. I saw them showing it to the staff and it was clearly not them. I don't want the university to get in trouble for underage drinking.
I’m being blackmailed by an ex-partner who says they will release private photos of me on the university Discord server if I don't give them money. I don't know who to talk to about this.
The fire exit in the basement of the chemistry lab is blocked by a bunch of old crates and equipment. If there was a fire, we wouldn't be able to get out. Please clear this immediately.
I’ve noticed a lot of non-students using the campus gym lately. They don't have badges and they are taking up all the equipment that we pay for with our tuition. Can we have stricter entrance checks?
My locker in the gym was broken into today. My watch and my wallet are gone. I thought those lockers were supposed to be secure, but the door was just pried open.
There is a stray dog on campus that looks very aggressive. It’s been growling at people walking to the dining hall and I’m worried it might bite a student who isn't paying attention.
I’m getting anonymous, threatening emails to my student account. They contain my home address and details about my daily schedule. I feel like I'm being stalked and I'm scared to leave my room.
I’d like to report that the vending machine in the student union has been tampered with. The coin slot is jammed with something and it looks like someone tried to pry the front panel off.
There’s a strong smell of gas in the hallway of the physics building. It’s getting stronger and making people feel dizzy. We need an evacuation and a check of the lines right now.
I saw someone trying to pick the lock on a parked scooter near the main gate. When they saw me, they tucked a tool into their pocket and walked away quickly toward the city side.
The back gate of the university is often left propped open with a rock so people can get in without their IDs. This completely defeats the purpose of having a fenced campus.
I lost my prescription glasses near the track field. They are in a red case. If they’ve been found, please let me know as I literally can't see my lectures without them.
There is an intruder in our dorm building. A man who doesn't live here is wandering the halls and knocking on doors asking for "the girl in the photo." He looks very agitated and is shouting.
Some students are using the roof of the library as a hangout spot. I saw them climbing up the fire escape earlier. It’s a long drop and they are sitting right on the edge.
I’d like to report a case of identity theft. Someone is using my student credentials to access the lab equipment and I’m getting billed for materials I never used. I need my account locked.
I noticed that the CCTV camera in the East parking lot has been spray-painted over. It’s been like that for two days, which means that whole area is currently unmonitored.
A student is being held against their will in a car in the south parking lot. I saw them struggling and shouting for help as the car drove off. The plate started with XYZ. Please help!
The "Authorized Personnel Only" door in the server room was left wide open today. There was nobody inside and all the hardware was exposed. This seems like a huge security oversight.
I think it would be a good idea to have more "Safe Walk" volunteers available during finals week. The library stays open 24/7 but many people are afraid to walk back to their cars at 4:00 AM.
I saw a student handing out flyers for an illegal gambling ring happening in the basement of the dorms. They are betting large amounts of money and things are getting tense between players.
There is an active fire in the trash bin behind the cafeteria. The flames are reaching the wooden fence nearby. We need a fire extinguisher and professional help immediately.
I witnessed a hit and run in the student parking lot. A silver SUV hit a parked motorcycle and just drove off without leaving a note. I have a partial license plate number if you need it.
I lost my student ID card somewhere between the gym and the library. I've already deactivated it, but if someone finds it, I'd like to get it back so I don't have to pay for a new one.
Someone is throwing water balloons from the 5th floor of the dorms at people walking below. It’s annoying and someone's laptop almost got ruined. Can someone go up there and tell them to stop?
My ex-boyfriend is standing outside my classroom and won't let me leave. He’s yelling and making a scene. I have a restraining order against him and he’s not supposed to be on campus.
There’s a group of people using the university's high-speed internet to host an illegal file-sharing server. It’s slowing down the connection for everyone else in the building.
I saw a man taking photos of students through the windows of the locker rooms. He ran away when he realized I saw him. He was wearing a grey hoodie and carrying a professional camera.
